requirements.item: Rebase onto Silicon Labs 26q3 without restoring the 26q1 core
requirements.evidence: Root 61d8ed59, Infrastructure 3bfa03fa and tlib 43a51de2 are ancestors of the candidate. Fresh source build succeeds.

requirements.item: Analyze and migrate the original Git delta
requirements.evidence: All 21 main mappings remain in branch history; six Infrastructure deltas have explicit retain/upstream-replacement decisions in SILABS_REBASE_REVIEW.json.

requirements.item: Account for all inventoried local source and board changes
requirements.evidence: All 17 unique C# variants and 51 overlay-related files have explicit dispositions. 47 migrated profiles load and compiled bus/clock/identity contracts pass. Retained physical fixes are central models; experimental controls have explicit exclusions. All 68 originals are hash-verified in the private materials backup.

requirements.item: Recover and preserve lab dependencies and dirty improvements
requirements.evidence: Original lab source and working patches are on two archive branches. Top-level OT 21c9cdd and distinct OTBR OT c6ec3c79 are published separately; OTBR 08d546a is preserved. SDK PASE/timeout changes retained and timeout parsing hardened with two unit tests.

requirements.item: Preserve the MG21 platform and CPU work
requirements.evidence: DeviceFamily, opt-in HFXO, platform and constrained MOV.W SP port pass component/ISA checks. The real HS1SA reset assertion is UDF #0x42 at 0x77bc, explicitly recorded by the historical experiment; stable vendor boot was already limited by bootloader/SE support.

requirements.item: Complete appropriate component and real-firmware regression
requirements.evidence: Existing crypto, BLE, mailbox, UART, GPIO, I2C, clocks, NOR, RNG, CPU and overlay reports retained. SEMAILBOX1 TXINT/multiword/reset five tests pass. Final audit fixed RF shadow/Storage0 reset: three baseline failures, six corrected tests, ten hostmailbox controls. Final bundled Ltech and LG complete native UDP CASE and Read/Toggle/Read with state changes.

requirements.item: Make the configuration reusable through rootless containers
requirements.evidence: A clean GitHub checkout builds all five host tools and Renode using docker/stock.sh build. Last pipeline exits 0 with Build succeeded, zero warnings/errors, SDK tests pass. Image needs only ELF/evidence mounts. Docker save/load tested; no host network or Docker socket mount.

requirements.item: Commit/push and preserve the requested materials on the user GitHub
requirements.evidence: Nine qualified branch heads match remote SHAs. Private Release payload and provenance digests match GitHub SHA256 values. Final audit publication is a documentation commit on the same branch.

legacy_limits: Quectel ThreadNetworkEnable timeout reproduced on the existing runtime.
MG21 HS1SA intentional UDF #0x42 at 0x77bc matches the historical experimental limit; stable vendor boot is not qualified.
Hostmailbox, Storage0, ACK and MLE/RA host timing compensation remain simulation settings.
Exact old DLL build provenance and original runtime-loaded LG subclass source are unavailable.
Existing production runtime is not replaced.
validation_scope: Retained source and compatibility contracts are migrated and tested. Deliberate diagnostic exclusions, physical timing/power fidelity, broad vendor coverage and old-DLL build provenance remain explicit limitations; this does not claim every vendor firmware fully boots or commissions.
